name: rocketjobs
description: Search the active job offers of rocketjobs.pl and get their details.

interface.longDescription: Job search for the Polish job market on rocketjobs.pl, across professions such as sales, finance, HR, marketing and logistics. Search the active job offers published on rocketjobs.pl by describing what you are looking for: role, city or remote work, experience level, contract type or minimum salary. Each result shows the company, location, work mode, the salary range when the employer discloses it, the requirements and a link to the offer on rocketjobs.pl, where you can apply. You can also ask for the full details of an offer: requirements, languages and the job description.
defaultPrompt: Praca w sprzedaży w Poznaniu na B2B
Zdalna praca w HR dla osoby bez doświadczenia
Oferty dla księgowej w Gdańsku na pełen etat

positive.prompt: Find sales jobs in Poznań on a B2B contract.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists sales offers located in Poznań with a B2B contract, each with its company, salary range when disclosed and a link to the offer on rocketjobs.pl, plus a link to the full list.

positive.description: Search by seniority and remote work
positive.prompt: Show me remote HR jobs for someone without experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists remote HR offers for juniors or trainees, with links to the offers.

positive.prompt: Find an accountant job in Gdańsk and tell me what the first offer requires.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds accountant offers in Gdańsk, then describes the first one: requirements, languages, salary per contract type and a link to apply.

positive.prompt: Find logistics jobs in Wrocław and then show me more of them.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists logistics offers in Wrocław, then calls search_offers again with page 2 and shows further offers without repeating the first ones.
Searches marketing offers, reports that the city is not known to the job board and was left out of the search, and does not present the offers as located there.

negative.prompt: Apply to this job for me and send my CV.
Write me a cover letter for a sales role.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments: it only searches public job offers.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search the active job offers with filters and get the details of an offer.
